introduction: I build RAG chatbots and AI agents for clients, and I write backend APIs in Python and Node.js. I work from Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.
about: I started as a backend developer at Yehulu Tech in 2016. My most recent employer was NDIT Solution, where I was AI, Backend & Automation Engineer from 2023 to 2025. On Upwork, my longest completed contract ran from October 2024 to April 2025: a knowledge-base chatbot built with retrieval-augmented generation. The assistant on this site streams its answers through the OpenAI Responses API and reads the same profile data you see here.
resumeSummary: AI and backend engineer who builds RAG chatbots and AI agents, with engineering roles from 2016 to 2025 and Upwork client work from October 2024.

faq.question: What does Lihon Gebre build?
faq.answer: Lihon builds AI chat assistants and agents that answer from retrieved data, together with the backend APIs they need. His Upwork jobs from June and July 2025 include a LangChain and LangGraph build for a SaaS product and a RAG AI agent.

faq.question: How do I contact Lihon Gebre about a role or a project?
faq.answer: Use the contact form on lihongebre.com or send him a message on LinkedIn. He works remotely from Addis Ababa, Ethiopia (UTC+3).

faq.question: Which stack does Lihon use for retrieval-augmented generation?
faq.answer: He works with LangChain and LangGraph, and uses Pinecone for vector search. The Academic Advisor AI and Only Hers case studies show two retrieval setups.

faq.question: Where can I check Lihon's work?
faq.answer: Each project on lihongebre.com has its own case study page. The code for Academic Advisor AI, Inventory Management and AI Customer Support is public at github.com/gelftheshot. On Upwork he is Top Rated, with 10 completed jobs and 9 written client reviews.
